question.text: Sometimes, the colour observed in Lassaigne's test for nitrogen is green. It is because

options.text: of green colour of ferrous sulphate
of green colour of copper sulphate
of excess of Fe $^{3+}$ ions whose yellow colour makes the blue colour of ferric ferrocyanide to appear green.

solution.text: Although blue coloured ferric ferrocyanide is formed but due to the presence of yellow coloured $\mathrm{Fe}^{3+}$ salts, the blue colour gives the shade of green.
